items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Howie Shear as the interviewee. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Howie was interviewed in Dunkirk, NY on October 11, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m talking with trumpeter Howie Shear, just outside Fredonia, and we were at Fredonia but I think I got out just before you came in.
